cards: Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe
notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting: Set Your Course For Alderaan, Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Alderaan, Prepared Defenses, Battle Order, Mobilization Points, Secret Plans; these count toward the 60. Three Effects start (via Prepared Defenses), so no single starting Effect is set.
Posted 'D' / 'DDB' / 'Alderaan' dested the Dark Death Star system, Death Star: Docking Bay 327 and Alderaan system the objective deploys.

Posted 'Dengar', 'Bossk', 'Fett' and 'Zuckass' under Starships dested the bounty hunter starships (Dengar In Punishing One, Bossk In Hound's Tooth, Boba Fett In Slave I, Zuckuss In Mist Hunter); 'Big E' dested Executor.
Posted '37201' dested 3,720 To 1 (the odds insert the strategy describes).
Posted 'Interceptor Cannons' dested SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons, the only starship weapon of the era that deploys on a TIE Interceptor (the strategy calls them 'the TIE cannons').
Posted 'other D sites x4' is printed as written (unnamed Death Star sites).
Secret Plans and Come Here You Big Coward were Effects in April 2001 (pre-Reflections III).
